mobile.home.title: Workspaces
mobile.home.emptyWaiting: No one is waiting on you
mobile.home.emptyWaitingSub: When an agent needs a decision, it shows up here.
mobile.home.connectingSub: If this takes a while, check that Kabul is open on the computer and that this device is on the same network (tailnet).
mobile.home.emptySub: Sessions and workspaces from this computer show up here automatically.
mobile.home.createSectionsHint: Create sections in the sidebar of the desktop app.
mobile.home.machineFooter: Your phone talks to this computer's kabuld over your tailnet. Other paired machines show up in the desktop app.
mobile.home.inviteNote: Whoever opens the link (over your tailnet) joins only this workspace: they see the stream, the chat and the terminal. Editors can also send messages, approve and type.
mobile.home.noWorkspaceHere: No Kabul workspace in this folder.
mobile.session.fitTitle: Resizes the tmux window to the phone screen (changes it for everyone)
mobile.session.observer: You are following as an observer.
mobile.session.whatToChange: What should change in the plan?
mobile.session.waitEditor: Waiting for an editor to decide.
mobile.session.queue: Queued ({n}) · sent in order when the turn ends
mobile.settings.title: Settings
mobile.settings.pushFooter: Lets you know when an agent stops and waits for your decision.
mobile.settings.pushToggle: Notify me when an agent is waiting on me
mobile.settings.forgetFooter: Forgetting deletes this device's credential. To come back, pair again with the QR code.
mobile.settings.name: Name
mobile.settings.revokeFooter: Revoking immediately drops the device's open connections.
mobile.settings.accountsNote: New chats use the checked account. To add an account or sign in, use Settings › Accounts in the desktop app.
mobile.settings.themeFooter: System follows the phone's light/dark mode.
mobile.settings.tagline: Parallel agents on your computer, live on your phone.
mobile.settings.updateHint: To update, on the Mac: Kabul › Check for Updates…
mobile.push.needsHttps: Notifications need HTTPS: on the Mac, turn on Tailscale HTTPS (Settings › Phone & remote) and open the https link.
mobile.push.iosHome: On iPhone, add Kabul to the Home Screen (Share › Add to Home Screen) and open it from there.
mobile.push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.
mobile.plan.prefix: [Plan mode] Before touching any file, present only a step-by-step plan and wait for my approval.
mobile.plan.label: Plan
mobile.runsOn.runningOnMirrored: Running on {machine}, mirrored to claude.ai and your phone
mobile.plan.emulatedTitle: The agent has no native plan mode: Kabul asks for the plan in the message
mobile.plan.nativeTitle: The agent plans without editing until you approve
mobile.app.incompatible: This app and the computer's kabuld are on versions that can't talk to each other.
mobile.app.inviteLead: You'll follow a Kabul workspace live with the person who invited you.
mobile.app.pairLead: Once paired, this device can see and drive the computer's sessions over your tailnet.
mobile.app.revokedLead: The machine's owner removed this device. Ask for a new QR code or invite.
mobile.app.needPairLead: On the computer, open Kabul › Settings › Phone & remote and point the camera at the QR code. Or paste the pairing link here.
mobile.new.title: New workspace
mobile.new.hintTitle: A workspace is an isolated copy of the repository
mobile.new.hintSub: The agent works on its own branch, without touching what's open on the computer.
mobile.new.promptPh: What do you want to work on?
mobile.new.addRepos: Add repositories in the desktop app.
mobile.new.planEmulated: In plan mode, the agent proposes a plan before touching any files. {model} has no native plan mode: Kabul emulates it with an instruction in the message.
mobile.new.planNative: In plan mode, the agent proposes a plan before touching any files.
mobile.model.cloudFooter: Runs in Anthropic's cloud (claude --cloud) and opens the session's terminal here.
mobile.model.accountFooter: To add an account or sign in, use Settings › Accounts in the desktop app.
mobile.pv.app.noPorts: This workspace has no reserved ports.
mobile.pv.app.lead: Workspace ports: {from}–{to} ({var}). Start the app with Run on the computer and open it here. It opens at a separate address, just for you.
mobile.pv.app.none: Nothing is running on the workspace ports right now.
mobile.pv.app.observer: Opening the app is for editors: observers can only follow along.
mobile.pv.ask.title: Ask in chat
mobile.pv.ask.noChat: No open chats in this workspace. Start one from the list (+ Chat) and come back here.
mobile.pv.ask.placeholder: What do you want to know about this excerpt?
mobile.pv.tooBig: {what} too large to format on the phone: showing the text in pages.
mobile.pv.pinch: pinch to zoom, double-tap to toggle
mobile.pv.opensSystem: Opens in the system viewer (with zoom and search).
mobile.pv.browser.closed: This workspace's browser is closed on the computer.
mobile.pv.browser.readOnly: Read only: the page you and the agents are using on the computer, refreshed every second and a half.
